Xiyu.name: Xiyu
notes: Yu Xiyu, narrator; idol in the boy band GREATEST (Daye Entertainment), youngest member, 15 at selection; grew up poor with a single mother; public persona innocent, privately independent and looks after his elder teammates. MINOR -- no romance translated while under 18.

Mother.name: Mother
notes: Xiyu's single mother, restaurant waitress paying off debts; gave all her savings to get him into the group.

Ruiyang.name: Ruiyang
notes: Bai Ruiyang, red hair, elder GREATEST teammate; stands by Xiyu during the scandal.
From a rich family; lends Xiyu a year of tuition ("so poor I only have money").

Song Wei.name: Song Wei
notes: GREATEST member, blond with headband; punches a trainee who insults Xiyu.

Zhang Suihan.name: Zhang Suihan
notes: GREATEST member, brown hair; blunt but promises the band will help Xiyu.
